page_title: BOU 2-1 EVE | Bournemouth v Everton 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
90+5' Dwight McNeil (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' 2 - 1 Seamus Coleman (Everton) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Bournemouth win a corner.
88' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Beto (Everton) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Neto and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominic Solanke trots off the pitch and is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
83' Beto (Everton) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
82' It will be a corner kick for Everton.
79' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Beto (Everton) replacing Amadou Onana.
76' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to James Tarkowski (Everton) for a tough tackle.
75' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) for Marcus Tavernier.
73' It will be a substitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is ready to enter the pitch as Justin Kluivert walks off.
72' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Abdoulaye Doucoure and he is replaced by Andre Gomes (Everton).
72' Today's match ends for Jack Harrison who will be replaced by Ashley Young (Everton).
71' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
69' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

64' 1 - 0 Lloyd Kelly sends a superb cross into the box. Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the roof of the net, leaving Jordan Pickford beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Milos Kerkez.
63' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
62' The game is interrupted as Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is flagged offside.
59' The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
56' Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
53' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

50' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Jordan Pickford pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
47' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle as Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
45+2' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
45+1' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' James Garner (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Bournemouth are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
44' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

44' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Samuel Barrott shows the yellow card to Amadou Onana (Everton) for a heavy challenge.
39' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
38' Bournemouth win a free kick. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
36' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle after Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
35' That was close by Dwight McNeil (Everton)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
33' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

32' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Neto's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner. The ball goes behind for a corner. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Looks like Amadou Onana (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
30' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
27' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).
24' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar.
24' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) steps up to send the ball in.
23' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is cleared to safety by the defence. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
19' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is about to take a corner kick.
19' Jack Harrison (Everton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Now Everton have a corner.
16' The corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared away by the defence.

16' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
15' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. Everton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
14' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
13' The corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is intercepted by the defence.

13' That's unlucky! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
10' A poor mid-range free-kick by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
10' James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a rough foul. Samuel Barrott stops the game and makes a call. Bournemouth have a free kick from a promising distance.
8' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
3' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
3' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Jordan Pickford gets down to his right to keep it out.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) heads on.
1' The first half has started.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
